title: Normalized internal scalar extension and geometric pullback
statement:
Let $a:\Lambda\to\Lambda'$ be a homomorphism of commutative condensed rings [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], and let $f:X\to Y$ be any morphism of schemes with small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. For $T=X,Y$ put $R_T=p_T^*\Lambda$, $S_T=p_T^*\Lambda'$ with ring map $a_T$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. Use the ordinary unbounded internal-module categories $D_R(T),D_S(T)$, the specified adjunctions $L_{f,R}\dashv F_{f,R}$ and $L_{f,S}\dashv F_{f,S}$ [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull], and uncompleted relative derived tensor [sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom]. Write $D_{a,T}=-\otimes^L_{R_T}S_T$ for derived scalar extension [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], and $V_T$ for exact scalar restriction [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. The comparison predicates and ordinary balancing maps are those fixed in [def-sfb-internal-derived-scalar-comparisons].

There exist natural isomorphisms $e_T:V_TD_{a,T}\xrightarrow{\sim}(-\otimes^L_{R_T}V_TS_T)$ and $\lambda_{f,a}:L_{f,S}D_{a,Y}\xrightarrow{\sim}D_{a,X}L_{f,R}$ satisfying respectively the universal computation-counit tensor normalization and scalar/pullback normalization of that interface. On flat-term K-flat representatives $e_T$ is the balanced map sending the scalar-extension generator $s\otimes x$ to $x\otimes s$; $\lambda_{f,a}$ sends $f^{-1}(x\otimes s)$ to $f^{-1}x\otimes f^{-1}s$ using the coefficient identifications $\alpha_f:f^{-1}R_Y\cong R_X$, $f^{-1}S_Y\cong S_X$ pulled from the point [sk-def-sfb-coefficient-morphisms], which are compatible with $a$ since both are components of one natural isomorphism $f^*p_Y^*\cong p_X^*$. Under the fixed internal/section module equivalences [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence], $D_{a,T}$ and these normalized maps identify with their section-ring K-flat constructions. The independently specified geometric derived adjunctions, including their units and counits, identify with the ringed-topos adjunctions under the same comparisons. These identifications are natural, independent of representatives, and require neither flatness of $a$ nor boundedness of the complexes.

proof.text: At X and Y use the canonical coefficient tensor normalization and its universal normalization theorem. Independently obtain the two normalized section scalar comparisons by lem-sfb-internal-section-scalar-normalization-existence and the normalized internal pullback comparison by lem-sfb-internal-pull-normalization-existence. Apply section tensor transport at both endpoints, and section pullback transport to the supplied comparisons. Assemble these witnesses and the eight conjuncts. All original definition data are publicly re-exported without change.

theorem internal_scalar_pullback_normalization (a : Λ ⟶ Λ') [IsMonHom a]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    ∃ (tX : TensorNormalization a X) (tY : TensorNormalization a Y)
      (b : D a Y ⋙ L Λ' f ≅ L Λ f ⋙ D a X)
      (sX : SectionScalarComparison a X) (sY : SectionScalarComparison a Y),
      TensorNormalized a X tX ∧ TensorNormalized a Y tY ∧ PullNormalized a f b ∧
      SectionScalarNormalized a X sX ∧ SectionScalarNormalized a Y sY ∧
      SectionTensorNormalized a X sX tX ∧ SectionTensorNormalized a Y sY tY ∧
      SectionPullNormalized a f sX sY b
